title: epilobium amurense f. leucanthum
intro: Epilobium amurense f. leucanthum, commonly known as the Amur wolf's-bane or White-flowered willowherb, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Epilobium amurense f. leucanthum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
